scope: General-purpose Linux hybrid computer use with native 1920x1080 GUI delivery and AX and GUI public tools.

implementation.image_identity_note: The release and rebuilt tested-candidate tags resolve to the same immutable containerd manifest ID; no runtime layer was rebuilt during promotion.

base_environment.rebuild_note: The original local tag was absent. The exact frozen beta59 source and Dockerfile were rebuilt before beta70; the reconstructed baseline source and MCP binary hashes match the v0.13 manifest. The current containerd exporter represents the rebuilt image with a different manifest identity.

source.tree_hash_contract: SHA-256 of sorted sha256sum output with ./ paths, excluding __pycache__ and *.pyc

contract.coordinate_space: pixels in the exact returned full-desktop image

promotion_evidence.acceptance: The user explicitly requested and accepted promotion to v0.14 on 2026-08-29 after the 1080p mechanism passed focused, complete runtime and real-container validation.

accepted_tradeoffs.score_claim: No new benchmark score is claimed. v0.14 inherits the latest audited v0.13 result until an exact v0.14 formal run completes.
accepted_tradeoffs.cost_claim: Native 1080p delivery can improve visual legibility but may increase image-token cost and latency on screenshot-heavy tasks.
accepted_tradeoffs.platform_claim: The promoted 1080p behavior is validated for the Linux provider; Windows and macOS parity is not claimed.

known_issues: No independent v0.14 formal benchmark or cost comparison has completed.
High-entropy 1920x1080 screenshots may require JPEG fallback and can exceed the preferred 480000-character base64 budget at minimum quality.
The exact tested image retains candidate-era component labels; the v0.14 tag and this immutable manifest are authoritative.
Native Windows and macOS providers require separate screenshot-resolution validation.
